_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P2 operational targets.

requirements.title: Scheduled policy execution
requirements.description: Add opt-in scheduled cleanup runs for eligible Safe and SafeWithOwner providers with explicit dry-run and audit retention controls.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:CLN-P2-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.title: Fleet cleanup intelligence
requirements.description: Aggregate cleanup estimates, provider health, and reclaim outcomes across scenarios to guide capacity planning and future storage governance.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:CLN-P2-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.title: Extended provider marketplace
requirements.description: Support registered scenario-owned providers with declarative metadata, contract validation, and reusable action discovery for future cleanup capabilities.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:CLN-P2-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.title: Advisory cross-platform declaration lint
requirements.description: Identify non-portable paths, platform mismatches, missing branches, and supersedable platform maps as warning-level declaration accountability findings.

validation.notes: Each warning-level cross-platform finding has positive and negative coverage in [REQ:CLN-P2-004].

requirements.title: Attributed storage growth and owner cleanup contract
requirements.description: Fit per-owner storage velocity from persisted census samples, project declared ceilings, and delegate preview-first cleanup to owner scenarios with explicit approval and idempotency.

validation.notes: Least-squares owner fits, six-sample device projection, ceiling status, owner contract transport, and cleanup idempotency are covered.

requirements.title: Provider policy reconciliation
requirements.description: Reconcile every registered cleanup provider into the active policy row while preserving deliberate operator disables and auditing additions.

validation.notes: Reconciliation adds missing providers without changing existing policy choices.

requirements.title: Explicit regenerable storage declarations
requirements.description: Require every storage entry to state regenerable and report unbounded regenerable entries or non-binding ceilings.

validation.notes: Conformance tests cover CEILING_NOT_BINDING and RETENTION_CEILING_UNBOUNDED; repository declarations pass the hidden-manifest audit.

requirements.title: Owner cleanup contract conformance
requirements.description: Provide a shared estimate, preview, apply, and verify owner cleanup contract with protected-item and idempotency guarantees.

validation.notes: HTTP transport tests cover blocked reasons, protected preview filtering, approval mode, and idempotent apply.

requirements.title: Warning pressure growth feedback
requirements.description: Forward warning pressure, run only the safe tier, and rate-limit a Scenario QA bug for the fastest unbounded owner.

validation.notes: Warning action, daily owner rate limit, and autonomous kill-switch behavior are covered; system-monitor forwards warning bands.
